title: Chitin Binding and Bradford Assay
author: Robert Hooftman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8akhscw
materials: Transfer the solutions + reagent to 1 ml cuvettes.

steps.title: Prepare chitin stock solution
steps.instruction: Make chitin buffer as described, then dissolve chitin to a final concentration of 10 mg ml⁻¹, yielding a stock solution.

steps.title: Add protein to microfuge tube
steps.instruction: In a 2 ml microfuge tube, pipette 50 µg of the protein of interest (chitin‑binding protein or a control such as BSA).

steps.title: Add chitin to tube
steps.instruction: Add 500 µg of chitin from the chitin stock (i.e., 50 µL of the 10 mg ml⁻¹ stock) to the tube while stirring the solution to ensure complete homogenization.

steps.title: Incubate mixture with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 1 hour on an Eppendorf shaking block set to 600 rpm to keep chitin suspended.

steps.title: Centrifuge reaction
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the tube in a tabletop centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare protein standards
steps.instruction: Prepare a series of protein standards with concentrations of 0, 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, 15, and 20 µg ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare sample dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the experimental sample as needed (e.g., 5‑fold and 20‑fold) to fall within the standard range.

steps.title: Add Bradford reagent
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Bradford reagent (Sigma) to each standard, diluted sample, and undiluted sample (1 : 1 reagent‑to‑sample ratio).

steps.title: Develop color
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixtures at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Measure blank absorbance
steps.instruction: Using a photospectrometer, measure absorbance at 595 nm (A595) for the 0 µg ml⁻¹ standard; record this value as the blank.

steps.title: Measure standards absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure A595 for each of the remaining protein standards.

steps.title: Generate standard curve
steps.instruction: Plot A595 (y‑axis) versus protein concentration (x‑axis), fit a trendline, and record the equation.

steps.title: Measure sample absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure A595 of the experimental sample(s); if the absorbance lies outside the standard range, re‑measure the appropriate diluted sample.

steps.title: Calculate protein concentration
steps.instruction: Calculate the sample protein concentration using the trendline equation, correcting for any dilution factor applied.
